answer: Builder's pick: micro-deposit bank seats. An ID earns only after its operator links a real bank account by reading back two random sub-dollar deposits, say 0.17 and 0.42, within 5 days (proposed). A salted hash of the account number is the seat key: one account, one ID. A hollow fleet of 50 IDs then needs 50 KYC'd accounts, and a shell bank on a knoll or a dune-side credit union still files real KYC. Fees cover the cents (proposed). Measured: 45 seats, 38 attested this window; mule-account rate unmeasured.
